toggles.name: MicrosoftStore
toggles.description: Removes Microsoft Store for all users or restores it for your account, downloading its package from Microsoft when needed.
toggles.warning: Disable removes Microsoft Store for every user on this PC. Enable restores it for your account only and may need an Internet connection.

toggles.name: ProcessExplorer
toggles.description: Replaces Task Manager with Sysinternals Process Explorer, or restores Task Manager.

toggles.name: ToggleWindowsUpdates
toggles.description: Windows Update services, scheduled tasks and policies through one menu launcher. Replay resolves the recorded state, so no SilentDefault is needed.
toggles.launcher: 6. Advanced Configuration\Toggle Windows Updates\Toggle Windows Updates.cmd

toggles.name: AdvancedBootOptions
toggles.description: Always go to the advanced boot options on each boot.
toggles.launcher: 6. Advanced Configuration\Boot Configuration\Behavior\Always Go to Advanced Boot Options.cmd

states.name: Disable
states.menuLabel: Disable always going to the advanced boot options (default)

states.name: Enable
states.menuLabel: Enable always going to the advanced boot options

toggles.name: AutomaticRepair
toggles.description: Windows Automatic Repair at boot (bootstatuspolicy).

toggles.name: BootLogo
toggles.description: Windows boot logo.

toggles.name: HighestMode
toggles.description: Highest graphical mode for boot applications.

toggles.name: KernelParameters
toggles.description: Editing of kernel parameters on startup.
toggles.launcher: 6. Advanced Configuration\Boot Configuration\Behavior\Editing Kernel Parameters on Startup.cmd

states.name: Disable
states.menuLabel: Disable editing of kernel parameters on startup (default)

states.name: Enable
states.menuLabel: Enable editing of kernel parameters on startup

toggles.name: NewBootMenu
toggles.description: New (Windows 8+) boot menu versus the legacy Windows 7 boot menu.

toggles.name: SpinningAnimations
toggles.description: Boot spinning animation.

toggles.name: ViewCurrentValues
toggles.description: Prints the current boot configuration (bcdedit /enum {current}); records no state.

toggles.name: AppStoreArchiving
toggles.description: Microsoft Store automatic app archiving.

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 3. General Configuration\Store App Archiving\Disable Store App Archiving (default).cmd

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 3. General Configuration\Store App Archiving\Enable Store App Archiving.cmd

toggles.name: AutomaticUpdates
toggles.description: Automatic Updates through the WindowsUpdate AU AUOptions policy.

toggles.name: BackgroundApps
toggles.description: Per-user global background app access.

toggles.name: ClickToDo
toggles.description: Click To Do through the Windows AI DisableClickToDo policy.

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 3. General Configuration\AI Features\Click To Do\Disable Click To Do (default).cmd

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 3. General Configuration\AI Features\Click To Do\Enable Click To Do.cmd

toggles.name: Copilot
toggles.description: Microsoft Copilot taskbar button, app and policy. Both states refresh Explorer so the taskbar updates. Copilot requires an installed Edge; on 24H2 it is delivered as a Store app installed through the trusted WinGet resolver.

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 3. General Configuration\AI Features\Microsoft Copilot\Disable Microsoft Copilot (default).cmd

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 3. General Configuration\AI Features\Microsoft Copilot\Enable Microsoft Copilot.cmd

toggles.name: CpuIdle
toggles.description: Processor idle-disable power setting. The powercfg value is inverted relative to the toggle (Disable Idle sets it to 1, Enable Idle to 0), and Disable is rejected on Hyper-Threading/SMT systems without changing or recording the state.

toggles.name: CpuIdleContextMenu
toggles.description: CPU Idle desktop context menu (HKCR DesktopBackground shell entry). The Command values invoke the CPU Idle launchers and are stored as REG_SZ with %windir% intentionally left unexpanded.

states.name: Add
states.launcher: 3. General Configuration\CPU Idle\Desktop Context Menu\Add Idle Toggle in Desktop Context Menu.cmd

states.name: Remove
states.launcher: 3. General Configuration\CPU Idle\Desktop Context Menu\Remove Idle Toggle in Desktop Context Menu (default).cmd

toggles.name: DeliveryOptimisation
toggles.description: Delivery Optimization through the DODownloadMode policy.

toggles.name: FileSharing
toggles.description: File Sharing (network discovery, SMB, NetBIOS bindings) through the same Operations helpers the fresh install uses; Enable optionally adds Network to the Explorer navigation pane.

toggles.name: FSOGameBar
toggles.description: Fullscreen Optimizations (FSO) and Game Bar / Game DVR support. Machine changes run as TrustedInstaller; current-user changes run in the caller's session.
toggles.warning: Changes the Game Bar and Game DVR services and packages. While disabled, Game Bar shortcuts, game recording and fullscreen optimizations are unavailable.

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 3. General Configuration\FSO and Game Bar\Disable FSO and Game Bar Support.cmd

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 3. General Configuration\FSO and Game Bar\Enable FSO and Game Bar Support (default).cmd

toggles.name: GiveAccessToMenu
toggles.description: Give access to (Sharing) context menu entries.

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 3. General Configuration\File Sharing\Give Access To Menu\Disable Give Access To Menu (default).cmd

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 3. General Configuration\File Sharing\Give Access To Menu\Enable Give Access To Menu.cmd

toggles.name: Hibernation
toggles.description: Hibernation (powercfg /hibernate) and the Start flyout hibernate option.

toggles.name: Indexing
toggles.description: Windows Search Indexing (disabled, minimal or full). Each state delegates the machine work to the installed indexing helper, so manual invocation and upgrade replay use the same TrustedInstaller action.

toggles.name: Location
toggles.description: Location services (lfsvc / MapsBroker) and Find My Device. The Enable prompt to unlock Find My Device is interactive-only so silent/upgrade re-apply never hangs; in silent mode Find My Device is preserved.

toggles.name: NetworkNavigationPane
toggles.description: Network item in the File Explorer navigation pane.

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 3. General Configuration\File Sharing\Network Navigation Pane\Disable Network Navigation Pane (default).cmd

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 3. General Configuration\File Sharing\Network Navigation Pane\Enable Network Navigation Pane.cmd

toggles.name: PauseUpdates
toggles.description: Pause Windows Updates through the WindowsUpdate UX and UpdatePolicy pause dates. Pause also records a days value under the AtlasOS\Services key, which some UI reads.
toggles.warning: Changes Windows Update policies. While updates are paused, security and driver updates do not install until you unpause them.

toggles.name: PhoneLink
toggles.description: Mobile Devices and Phone Link: the CDPSvc service, cross-device resume and the YourPhone app. The settings page is opened only for an interactive enable.

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 3. General Configuration\Mobile Devices (Phone Link)\Disable Mobile Device Settings (default).cmd

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 3. General Configuration\Mobile Devices (Phone Link)\Enable Mobile Device Settings.cmd

toggles.name: PowerSaving
toggles.description: Power-saving: the documented Atlas AC power policy versus the prior power plan. Both states use the same helper.

toggles.name: Recall
toggles.description: Recall and Windows AI data analysis through the DisableAIDataAnalysis policy.

toggles.name: Sleep
toggles.description: Sleep power-scheme settings, with an optional hibernation follow-up on an interactive disable.

toggles.name: SleepStudy
toggles.description: Sleep Study diagnostic event logs and the Power Efficiency Diagnostics scheduled task.

toggles.name: SystemRestore
toggles.description: System Restore policy. Enable also turns on protection for the Windows volume; it does not create a restore point or enable other volumes.

toggles.name: TimerResolution
toggles.description: Global timer resolution: a scheduled task that forces a high timer resolution.
toggles.warning: Changes the global timer request policy and an Atlas scheduled task. A forced high timer resolution can increase power use; any latency benefit depends on the workload.

toggles.name: UpdateDrivers
toggles.description: Run the Update Drivers helper. A plain action launcher that records no state.

toggles.name: UpdateNotifications
toggles.description: Windows Update restart notifications.

toggles.name: WebSearch
toggles.description: Web Search and Search Highlights. Explorer and SearchHost are refreshed unless the launcher was called with /noAction. Enable installs the Bing search provider through the trusted WinGet resolver and, with search indexing stopped, offers to enable indexing (a graphical-bug fix).

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 3. General Configuration\Web Search (includes Search Highlights)\Disable Web Search (default).cmd

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 3. General Configuration\Web Search (includes Search Highlights)\Enable Web Search.cmd

toggles.name: Widgets
toggles.description: Widgets (News and Interests) feeds. The Edge/WebView helper and the ms-settings:taskbar page are gated to interactive mode so upgrade re-apply never blocks.

toggles.name: WindowsSpotlight
toggles.description: Windows Spotlight: lock screen, tips, suggestions and spotlight content. The HKLM CloudContent policy is machine work; the per-user values are user work.

toggles.name: Workplace
toggles.description: Workplace (Access work or school) settings page visibility. The page is opened interactively only.
toggles.warning: Hides or shows the Access work or school Settings page. While hidden, this PC cannot be joined to a work or school account from Settings.

toggles.name: Animation
toggles.description: Visual effects and animations: the Atlas minimal set or the Windows defaults. Both states offer a sign-out afterwards so the changes apply.

states.name: Default
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\Visual Effects (Animations)\Default Windows Visual Effects.cmd

toggles.name: AppIconThumbnail
toggles.description: Application icon overlays on File Explorer thumbnails.

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\File Explorer Customization\App Icons on Thumbnails\Disable App Icons on Thumbnails.cmd

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\File Explorer Customization\App Icons on Thumbnails\Enable App Icons on Thumbnails (default).cmd

toggles.name: AutomaticFolderDiscovery
toggles.description: Automatic folder type discovery in File Explorer.

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\File Explorer Customization\Automatic Folder Discovery\Disable Automatic Folder Discovery (default).cmd

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\File Explorer Customization\Automatic Folder Discovery\Enable Automatic Folder Discovery.cmd

toggles.name: CompactView
toggles.description: Compact view (reduced item spacing) in File Explorer.

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\File Explorer Customization\Compact View\Disable Compact View.cmd

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\File Explorer Customization\Compact View\Enable Compact View (default).cmd

toggles.name: ContextMenuTerminals
toggles.description: The Terminals context menu: removed, full, or without Windows Terminal. Each state is applied from its .reg file under Scripts\Registry\Terminals.

states.name: Remove
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\Context Menus\Terminals\Remove Terminals Context Menu (default).cmd

states.name: AddNoWindowsTerminal
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\Context Menus\Terminals\Add Terminals (no Windows Terminal).cmd

toggles.name: EdgeSwipe
toggles.description: Edge Swipe gesture on touch screens.

toggles.name: ExtractContextMenu
toggles.description: Extract entry in the file context menu, controlled by blocking or unblocking the archive shell extensions.

toggles.name: Gallery
toggles.description: Gallery item in the File Explorer navigation pane.

toggles.name: Home
toggles.description: Home item in the File Explorer navigation pane and its default launch target.

toggles.name: LockScreen
toggles.description: Windows lock screen (policy show or hide). Show verifies the policy values are really gone after removal.

toggles.name: ModernBatteryFlyout
toggles.description: Modern or old (Windows 8-style) battery flyout.

states.name: Modern
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\Old Flyouts\Battery Flyout\Modern Battery Flyout (default).cmd

states.name: Old
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\Old Flyouts\Battery Flyout\Old Battery Flyout.cmd

toggles.name: ModernDateTime
toggles.description: Modern or old (Windows 8-style) date and time (tray clock) flyout.

states.name: Modern
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\Old Flyouts\Date and Time Flyout\Modern Date and Time Flyout (default).cmd

states.name: Old

toggles.description: Modern or old (Windows 8-style) volume flyout.

states.name: Modern
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\Old Flyouts\Volume Flyout\Modern Volume Flyout (default).cmd

states.name: Old
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\Old Flyouts\Volume Flyout\Old Volume Flyout.cmd

toggles.name: OldContextMenu
toggles.description: Windows 11 file context menu: the old full menu or the new compact menu.

toggles.name: QuickAccess
toggles.description: Quick Access in File Explorer (HubMode hides it).

states.name: Remove
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\File Explorer Customization\Quick Access\Remove Quick Access.cmd

states.name: Show
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\File Explorer Customization\Quick Access\Show Quick Access (default).cmd

toggles.name: RecentItems
toggles.description: Recent Items and app or document usage tracking. Both states also hide or unhide the general privacy settings page and refresh Explorer and Settings.

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\Unlock Recent Items\Disable Recent Items (default).cmd

states.name: Unlock
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\Unlock Recent Items\Unlock Recent Items.cmd

toggles.name: RemovableDrivesInSidebar
toggles.description: Removable drives in the File Explorer navigation pane.

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\File Explorer Customization\Removable Drives in Sidebar\Disable Removable Drives in Sidebar (default).cmd

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\File Explorer Customization\Removable Drives in Sidebar\Enable Removable Drives in Sidebar.cmd

toggles.name: RestartExplorer
toggles.description: Restart Windows Explorer. The engine performs the restart through Reboot = RestartExplorer (which /noaction suppresses), so the action only prints status and no state is recorded.

toggles.name: RunWithPriority
toggles.description: The Run with priority cascading entry in the .exe context menu.

states.name: Add
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\Context Menus\Run With Priority\Add Run With Priority In Context Menu.cmd

states.name: Remove
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\Context Menus\Run With Priority\Remove Run With Priority In Context Menu (default).cmd

toggles.name: SendToContextMenu
toggles.description: Hides or shows entries of the Explorer Send To context menu for the current user. Interactive by default; /silent applies the Atlas defaults. Runs in the user's own session and records no state.

states.name: Debloat
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\Context Menus\Send To\Debloat Send To Context Menu.cmd

toggles.name: ShortcutIcon
toggles.description: Shortcut overlay icon: the default arrow, the classic arrow or none.

toggles.name: ShortcutText
toggles.description: The " - Shortcut" text suffix on newly created shortcuts.

toggles.name: SnapLayouts
toggles.description: Snap Layouts: the Snap Assist flyout and bar.

toggles.name: TakeOwnership
toggles.description: The Take Ownership context menu entries. Each state is applied from its .reg file under Scripts\Registry\TakeOwnership.

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\Context Menus\Take Ownership\Remove Take Ownership to Context Menu (default).cmd

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\Context Menus\Take Ownership\Add Take Ownership to Context Menu.cmd

toggles.name: VerboseMessages
toggles.description: Verbose (detailed) startup and shutdown status messages.

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\Verbose Status Messages\Disable Verbose Messages (default).cmd

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 4. Interface Tweaks\Verbose Status Messages\Enable Verbose Messages.cmd

toggles.name: ConfigVBS
toggles.description: Shows the current Virtualization-Based Security configuration once; records no state.

toggles.name: FaultTolerantHeap
toggles.description: Fault Tolerant Heap (FTH) mitigation.

toggles.name: HideAppBrowserControl
toggles.description: Hides or shows the App and Browser Control page in Windows Security.

states.name: Hide
states.launcher: 7. Security\Defender\Hide App and Browser Control\Hide App and Browser Control (default).cmd

states.name: Show
states.launcher: 7. Security\Defender\Hide App and Browser Control\Show App and Browser Control.cmd

toggles.name: Mitigations
toggles.description: Exploit and process mitigations: speculative-execution overrides, SEHOP, CFG, DEP (nx) and the kernel mitigation masks.

toggles.name: SecurityHealthTray
toggles.description: Windows Security (Defender) tray icon startup entry, applied from the shipped .reg assets.

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 7. Security\Defender\Security Health Tray\Remove Security Tray from Startup (default).cmd

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 7. Security\Defender\Security Health Tray\Add Security Tray to Startup.cmd

toggles.name: ToggleDefender
toggles.description: Installs or uninstalls Windows Defender through the NoDefender CBS package helper. The menu runs in the administrator window and its choice crosses the silent TrustedInstaller broker as a fixed internal state; records no state.

toggles.name: VbsState
toggles.description: Documented Virtualization-Based Security and memory-integrity configuration.

toggles.name: Bluetooth
toggles.description: Bluetooth drivers, services, devices, the Send To entry and the connectivity policy.
toggles.warning: Changes the Bluetooth services and drivers and disables or enables every Bluetooth device. While disabled, Bluetooth devices stop working.

toggles.name: LanmanWorkstation
toggles.description: Lanman Workstation and SMB services plus the SmbDirect feature.
toggles.warning: Changes the SMB client services. While disabled, this PC cannot open network shares, mapped drives or network printers.

toggles.name: NetworkDiscovery
toggles.description: Network Discovery services. Enable first enables SMB; network profiles and firewall discovery rules remain separate choices in Advanced sharing settings. Explorer visibility is controlled by Network Navigation Pane.
toggles.warning: Changes the network discovery services. While disabled, this PC cannot find or be found by other devices on the network.

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 6. Advanced Configuration\Services\Network Discovery\Disable Network Discovery Services.cmd

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 6. Advanced Configuration\Services\Network Discovery\Enable Network Discovery Services (default).cmd

toggles.name: NVidiaDisplayContainer
toggles.description: NVIDIA Display Container LS service. Both states apply only while the service is installed, so a recorded state is dropped on upgrade once the driver is gone.
toggles.warning: Changes the NVIDIA Display Container LS service. While disabled, the NVIDIA Control Panel and most NVIDIA driver features stop working.

states.name: Disable
states.launcher: 6. Advanced Configuration\Services\NVIDIA Display Container\Disable NVIDIA Display Container LS.cmd

states.name: Enable
states.launcher: 6. Advanced Configuration\Services\NVIDIA Display Container\Enable NVIDIA Display Container LS (default).cmd

toggles.name: NVidiaDisplayContainerContextMenu
toggles.description: Desktop context menu that enables or disables the NVIDIA Display Container LS service.
toggles.warning: Adds or removes a desktop context menu that stops or starts the NVIDIA Display Container LS service. Stopping it disables the NVIDIA Control Panel and most NVIDIA driver features.

states.name: Add
states.launcher: 6. Advanced Configuration\Services\NVIDIA Display Container\Context Menu\Add Container Context Menu.cmd

states.name: Remove
states.launcher: 6. Advanced Configuration\Services\NVIDIA Display Container\Context Menu\Remove Container Context Menu (default).cmd

toggles.name: Printing
toggles.description: Printing services, Windows features and the Print context menu entries. The context menu part can be run alone with /justcontext.
toggles.warning: Changes the printing services and Windows printing features. While disabled, printers, Print to PDF, XPS and the Print Management console do not work.

toggles.name: SuperFetch
toggles.description: SuperFetch (SysMain) and ReadyBoost.
toggles.warning: Changes the SysMain and ReadyBoost services. While disabled, Windows no longer preloads frequently used apps, and ReadyBoost is unavailable.

toggles.name: InstallSoftware
toggles.description: Opens the Atlas software picker. Records no state.

toggles.name: RemoveEdge
toggles.description: Install or remove Microsoft Edge through its interactive helper, hosted in the administrator window the engine opens. Records no state.

toggles.name: RemovePythonStorePrompt
toggles.description: Opens Advanced app settings for selecting App execution aliases and disabling only the App Installer Python Store prompts, preserving installed Python distributions. Requires user selection and records no state.

toggles.name: AtlasHealth
toggles.description: Reports what Atlas installed and which recorded toggle states or install tweaks have since drifted. Changes nothing and records no state.

toggles.name: DefaultAtlasNetwork
toggles.description: Network adapter reset to Atlas defaults or Windows defaults. Both states share the Atlas.Network Set-AtlasNetworkDefaults implementation with the Toolbox.

toggles.name: FixErrors2502and2503
toggles.description: Fixes installer errors 2502 and 2503 by resetting the Windows TEMP folder permissions. Records no state.

toggles.name: FixMSStoreIssues
toggles.description: Fixes Microsoft Store issues by running StoreFixer. Records no state.

toggles.name: RepairWindowsComponents
toggles.description: Repairs Windows components and system files with DISM RestoreHealth and SFC. Records no state.
toggles.warning: Repairs corrupt Windows components and system files with DISM and SFC. It can take a long time and needs an Internet connection for missing files. Atlas settings are not reverted.

toggles.name: SafeMode
toggles.description: Safe Mode boot configuration. Safe mode is a transient troubleshooting state, so it is never recorded: an upgrade replay must never boot the machine back into safe mode from a stale record.

states.name: CommandPrompt
states.launcher: 9. Troubleshooting\Safe Mode\Safe Mode with Command Prompt.cmd

toggles.name: TelemetryComponents
toggles.description: Adds or removes the Atlas NoTelemetry CBS package. The menu runs in the administrator window and its choice crosses the silent TrustedInstaller broker as a fixed internal state; records no state.
